# ADR-3264: AWS root_mfa: Shared root password manager entry for team 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Shared root passwords defeat accountability.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT keep a shared root password manager entry for team 8 (AWS-root_mfa-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Break-glass sealed envelopes replace sharing.
